proposal.reason: Primary change is communicator configuration lifecycle: new config fields are parsed/validated/defaulted, env-overridden, stored on comm state, and rank-synchronized in init. enqueue is additionally needed because graphUsageMode changes strong-stream capture/mixing semantics (strongstream API/behavior and enqueue/channel call paths). device-topology is additionally needed because P2P channel/peer budgeting logic is changed in topology path/channel computation (nChannelsPerNetPeer and maxP2pPeers effects).
